meta_data.base_class: Fetch the price of a specific artwork listed on <fine art auction platform> platform - refers to a professional organization or digital marketplace that facilitates the auction of high-value artworks, such as Sotheby's or Christie's.

tool_template.name: fetch_<class>_artwork_price
tool_template.description: Fetch the price of a specific artwork on the <class> platform.

artwork_name.description: The name of the artwork to be searched on the <class> platform.

artist.description: The artist's name to ensure the precise artwork is fetched on the <class> platform.

currency.description: The currency in which the price of the artwork should be fetched on the <class> platform. Common options include USD, EUR, GBP, etc.

include_tax.description: Indicates whether to include taxes in the fetched price of the artwork on the <class> platform.

price_range.description: An array containing two numbers representing the minimum and maximum price range to filter artworks on the <class> platform.

date_of_auction.description: The date of the auction event in which the artwork's price is to be fetched from the <class> platform, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

authentication_required.description: Indicates whether user authentication is required to access artwork prices on the <class> platform.
